title: Tôi cần quản lý
summary: Say "I need the manager" with Tôi cần quản lý, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Tôi cần quản lý is the phrase to keep ready for "I need the manager" in lost items, help, managers, and recovery moments. This is for when the staff cannot solve the problem and you need escalation. This is a practical escalation phrase, not a dramatic one. It works best when you focus on putting the need first and leaving room for the helper to confirm the detail. After you say it, listen for a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Listen to each piece, then the whole phrase, so the rhythm feels connected instead of memorized word by word.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Tôi cần quản lý as your first sentence for "I need the manager". This is for when the staff cannot solve the problem and you need escalation. Leave a short pause after the phrase so the other person can answer with a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question. Keep a receipt, room number, ride detail, or last location visible when it helps staff trace the problem.

sections.title: Why it matters

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Problems & Help, the reply often comes as a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question. Say Tôi cần quản lý once, pause, and watch for the reply before adding another sentence. Keep a receipt, room number, ride detail, or last location visible when it helps staff trace the problem.
